$comment: FIX-019 human/hardware event-trace template. Fill ONE template per run (one run = one launcher x one mode interview). Fields match the event-trace contract: { runId, launcher, sessionId, questionKey, inputMode, eventKind, ts }. questionKey comes ONLY from packages/candice-protocol/schemas/question-inventory.json active records (BUILD_TARGET, KAZEN_*, ELI5_REVIEWED_ZERO, BRO_REVIEWED_ZERO). Retired B3/C7/C8 exist in the inventory but are never used by a run. NEVER put question text, answer text, secrets, API keys, or raw audio in this file — keys and codes only (FIX-017 boundary).
$countedSequenceComment: Ordered questionKey list of every counted question as asked, e.g. ["BUILD_TARGET", "BUILD_TARGET"] — one entry per counted occurrence including re-asks after restart (re-ask keeps counted:false per section 20, so record it only when the run's own numbering counted it). QC replays this sequence against the ceiling oracle (interview.md ceiling arithmetic + candice-question-contract.md). A mismatch is a tier FAIL.
